## YTD Studio 2.2.0: playlists that play themselves

**Which file do I need?**

| File | For |
| --- | --- |
| `…-2.2.0-setup.exe` | Windows installer |
| `YTD-Studio-2.2.0-mac-arm64.dmg` | Macs with Apple Silicon (M1 and newer). **Most Macs from 2021 on.** |
| `YTD-Studio-2.2.0-mac-x64.dmg` | Intel Macs |
| `YTD-Studio-2.2.0-iOS-unsigned.ipa` | iPhone and iPad, installed with a sideloading tool (see the README) |
| `YTD-Studio-2.2.0-arm64-v8a-release.apk` | Practically every Android phone. **Use this one.** |
| `YTD-Studio-2.2.0-armeabi-v7a-release.apk` | Old 32-bit Android phones |
| `YTD-Studio-2.2.0-x86_64-release.apk` | Android emulator / Chromebooks |

### Stream whole playlists (Windows and macOS)
Paste a playlist into the Stream tab, or press **Play all** on Home, and it plays one video after another, ad-free. No more going back to YouTube to pick the next one.

- **Autoplay**: when a video ends, the next one starts, also while you are on another tab. It is fetched a few seconds ahead, so it starts right away. Turn it off with the *Autoplay the next video* switch.
- **Up next** list: see what is coming and click any video to play it.
- **Previous / Next** under the video, **Shift+N / Shift+P**, and your keyboard's media keys. **Shuffle** and **Repeat** the playlist.
- Paste a video link that is part of a playlist (`watch?v=…&list=…`) and it starts there.
- Home offers **Play all**, **Shuffle** and **Listen** (audio only) for any playlist; Ctrl+K and the copied-link prompt can play one too.
- Fullscreen, picture-in-picture, volume and the quality you picked carry over from one video to the next. Private or removed videos are skipped.

### Only the playlist you pasted
A link that lists other playlists (a channel's tabs, a *Playlists* page, a playlist inside a playlist) used to pull in every video of all of them. Now you get **only that link's own videos**. The playlists inside it are shown separately under *Also in this link*, so you can open just the one you want. A channel's main page opens its **Videos** tab instead of Videos + Shorts + Live together, and `[Private video]` placeholders are left out.

Channels you already follow are fine: their first sync after the update takes the channel's current videos as the starting point instead of downloading the whole channel again. This fix is in the desktop and Android apps.

### Android: skip sponsors while watching
The Android player now jumps over sponsor reads, self-promotion and "like and subscribe" parts as they come (SponsorBlock), with a **Watch it** button to undo. It works for streams and for downloads that still contain those parts. As on desktop, only the first four characters of a hash of the video id are sent, so SponsorBlock never learns what you watch. Turn it off in Settings > Playback.

> Android: if your previous APK was signed with a different key (see the README), uninstall it before installing this one.
